topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines student learning outcomes, and previews the core themes of cancer biology.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Cellular Differentiation and Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the biological basis of cancer as a breakdown in cellular differentiation and tissue organization, alongside the experimental challenges of modeling this architecture in vitro.

topics.label: Distinction and Classification of Benign and Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how benign and malignant tumors are differentiated by their invasive capacity, progression potential, and diagnostic nomenclature.

topics.label: Pathological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical and systemic mechanisms through which local tumor expansion and metastatic dissemination cause disease and death.

topics.label: Tumor Incidence Across Humans and Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine patterns of tumor incidence and mortality in human populations and compare them with cancer occurrence across diverse animal species.

topics.label: Clinical Detection and Screening Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and compare the effectiveness of screening methods across different tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes and providing reminders for upcoming practical sessions.
